content: CSM learns how to rank characters. We can measure the interdependencies between the HLA variables BIBREF29 and rank the similarity between the TV show characters. We use implicit feedback instead of neighborhood models (e.g. cosine similarity) because it can compute latent factors to transform both characters and HLAs into the same latent space, making them directly comparable.
